title: Floquet Dressing and Bath Spectral Effects on the Geometric Phase of a Driven Dissipative Qubit
summary: The geometric phase (GP) of a periodically driven symmetricspin-boson model (SBM) is investigated using the process-tensor time-evolving matrix product operator (PT-TEMPO) method. A longitudinal monochromatic field drives the qubit along the \emph{same} coordinate that couples to an Ohmic bosonic environment. The gauge-invariant kinematic GP is evaluated from the reduced-statetrajectory, and a circular non-additivity measure quantifies the combined effects of driving and dissipation relative to driven-unitary and undriven-dissipative references.
